newsitem.title: USA: Flow sees Q4 charge, exploring strategies.
newsitem.headline: Flow sees Q4 charge, exploring strategies.

text.p: Flow International Corp said Thursday it plans to take a charge of up to $9 million in the fourth quarter in a restructuring effort to focus on its core technology.
Additionally, the company said it in the process of hiring an investment banker to analyze strategic alternatives.
Earlier today the maker of ultrahigh-pressure waterjet cutting and cleaning systems reported third quarter earnings of $0.09 per share, compared to $0.08 per share a year-ago.
"Over the next few months, we will take a number of steps to focus FLOW on its core technology while exploring strategic alternatives for the other businesses," the company said in a release.

"In addition to streamlining our corporate structure, we will devote additional resources to research and development to expand the applications for UHP technology to maximize the opportunities that we are seeing in the food, automotive and other business lines," it said.
